reviewer: independent development subagent industrial_sources, not external human or institution
scope: Real binary64 research provider only, <=4096 rows; no production enablement or industrial matrix execution

findings.before: Provider silently converted exact rational requested shift to float and only bounded subtraction of that effective float. On n1 A=nextafter(1,+inf), requested=1+2^-54, D=2^-52, returned bound about4.93e-32 while exact requested-shift residual is2^-54 about5.55e-17.
findings.production_impact: None: provider disabled in production; separate exact residual verifier recomputes original requested-shift residual and would reject.
findings.fix: Preserve requested shift as Fraction, bound absolute requested/effective conversion defect by nextafter to +infinity, outward-add it to every diagonal seed error, return both requested_shift and effective_shift.

math_checks.offdiagonal_identity: For actual saved yi and lki, ei=yi-Di*lki. Expanding the numerical update sequence yields each original offdiagonal residual as current division defect plus earlier saved L coefficients times earlier division defects plus the local update rounding defects. Recorded Yerr_i already sums those terms.
math_checks.no_Yerr_i_propagation: No additional propagation of Yerr_i is needed: subsequent updates use the actual stored yi, rather than an uncertain ideal yi. The exact difference between that actual yi and Di*lki is ei. Propagating Yerr_i again would double-count earlier residual terms.
math_checks.diagonal_identity: Original diagonal minus requested shift minus sum(lki^2 Di) minus stored Dk equals shift/subtraction defect plus sum of diagonal FMA rounding defects plus sum(lki*ei), up to irrelevant sign convention for the rounding defects. Triangle bounds cover signs.
math_checks.rounding_bound: Under stated correctly rounded binary64 operations and FE_TONEAREST, a full upward ulp of the stored FMA result conservatively bounds the local rounding error, including zero and gradual underflow; max-finite outward step produces infinity and rejection.
math_checks.division_defect: abs(fma(-Di,lki,yi)) then nextafter(+inf) encloses absolute exact division defect for the actual saved lki; no relative-error assumption or good pivot conditioning is needed.
math_checks.upper_accumulation: All nonnegative bound sums/products take nextafter(+inf). Underflow to zero is inflated to minimum positive subnormal; overflow/nonfinite bounds refuse.
math_checks.shift_binding: Reviewed requested rational to effective binary64 defect is now included in every original diagonal bound; permutation of seed_errors follows original-row mapping. Independently checked nonrepresentable decimal rational shifts at extreme scales and shift2^-1200 underflowing to0.
math_checks.symmetry: Exact symmetric stored input required; unique sorted entries verified from buffers, not cached canonical flag. Each offdiagonal residual upper bound is added to both corresponding factor-order row sums.
math_checks.permutation_and_storage: Parent/P/Pinv and L column layout match the official left-looking LDL algorithm; random permutations checked against independent exact original-coordinate row residuals.
math_checks.environment_and_build: Inspected Apple local fma/nextafter manuals and build flags; binary64/round-to-nearest/gradual-underflow runtime checks, -fno-fast-math and -ffp-contract=off, C/Python/binary hashes bind the local build. This is conditional execution evidence, not formal machine verification or adversarially authenticated source provenance.

independent_details: 30 n9 real indefinite matrices with random permutations and exact rational requested shifts2^exponent/10, exponents -1000,-400,0,400,1000; every row bound independently compared with Fraction residual
verification.test_oracle_scope: Dense conversion/triple products only for <=9-row independent test oracles, never production or industrial matrix.

remaining_limitations: No numerical pivoting: zero or poor pivots can refuse or produce unusably large bounds
Only real arithmetic and the tested macOS arm64 build reviewed; complex and other floating/compiler/platform environments not established
No cancellation callback or hard process/disk guard in research C call; bounded input/fill/operations do not replace production supervision
Existing memmap export still constructs bounded CSR factor copies; not a large-scale zero-copy or full OOC implementation
User-supplied bound arrays must never be accepted directly as certificates; rerun trusted bound computation or independently verify explicit factors
Endpoint inertia composition still needs target order, multiplicity, rank and original-candidate residual checks
No GSM factorization residual certificate or industrial complete-mode claim from these tests
